item.title: Reminder (ponaglenie) for an authority's inaction
item.description:
A ponaglenie is the simplest and most effective step when your case is stuck. You file it with the higher-instance authority, but through the authority handling your case.

  • For a voivode’s decision the higher authority is the Head of the Office for Foreigners.
  • The authority has 7 days to forward the reminder together with the file.
  • The higher authority decides within 7 days.

In the 14 cases we tracked, a reminder moved the decision forward by roughly 3 months. In 4 cases it changed nothing.
